# Little Jem

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v4 c40 P53](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0053)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Little Jem  <sub>[v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v4 c35 P41](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0041), [v4 c39 P21](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0021), [v4 c40 P36](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0036), [v4 c40 P53](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0053)</sub>; Jem  <sub>[v4 c40 P24](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Little Jem is described as perfectly beautiful and has dimples in his elbows.

_Sources: [v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004)_

## History

Little Jem was born to Anne and Gilbert Blythe in their house of dreams, bringing the sweetness of motherhood back to Anne following the loss of her firstborn, Joyce. Miss Cornelia and Anne agreed that they would raise him to be a good Conservative. Captain Jim arranged to leave a few curious items he had collected to Little Jem. As he grew, his clothes were shortened, though his mother was relieved to find him her same baby when dressed in his long nightie at bedtime.

_Sources: [v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v4 c35 P41](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0041), [v4 c40 P36](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0036), [v4 c40 P53](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0053)_
